title: Meri Janib Palat Aa Hussain
body:
Raah E Qaliq Me Jab Ghar Ka Ghar De Chuke
noor Ankho'n Ka Tha Jo Pisar De Chuke
ghaiz Me Khainch Kar Zulfeqar-e-ali
bole Sheh Dekh Kar Su-e-laash-e-jari
mere Ghazi Utho Jung Dekho Meri
aayi Itne Me Rab Ki Sada
<<MINI>>
irjayi Irjayi Ya Hussain
meri Janib Palat Aa Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Laaj Rakhle Mere Ishq Ki Baat Hai
mere Bande Yeh Waqt-e-mulaqaat Hai
rokle Rokle Teghe Khaibar Kusha

2. Har Ghareeb-ul-watan Ne Pukara Mujhe

meesum
3. Ab Na Akbar Na Abbas Koi Nahi

6. Ek Musafer Pe Tegho'n Ki Yalghaar Hai
aik Bekas Pe Teero'n Ki Bochaar Hai

7. Faqr Ki Baat Hai Tera Qaleq Hu Mai
mera Aashiq Hai Tu Tera Aashiq Hu Mai

8. Gham Me Farzand Ke Roushni Chal Basi

<<MINI>>

9. Sunke Moula Ne Aawaaz-e-rabb-e-seher

10. Mere Bando'n Me Tujh Jaisa Banda Nahi
zere Khanjar Bhi Tu Mujh Ko Bhoola Nahi

<<MINI>>

meri Janib Palat Aa Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Imteha'n Tera Poora Huva Asr Par

12. Bekaso'n Ki Qasam Aye Bilal-e-hazeen
